title.en: Janai Kata no Hakushaku Reijou - Hitochigai de Kyuukonsareta no de Hadan ni shite Sashiagemasu

altTitles.ja: じゃない方の伯爵令嬢 人違いで求婚されたので破談にして差し上げます

altTitles.en: I Got Engaged by Mistake… So I’ll End It Myself!

description.en:
Liosette Madal, the only daughter of a count’s family, is facing her sixth broken engagement.
And each time, the reason is the same:
Her name is almost identical to the most famous lady in high society—Liosette Dadel!

In this world, unmarried women are not allowed to show their faces in public, and engagements typically begin through written letters.
So the mistake happens over and over—men send proposals believing she’s that Liosette… only to realize their mistake too late.

Having grown used to the cycle, Liosette now takes it upon herself to gracefully end the engagement each time, preserving the other party’s dignity and reputation.

But this time, she receives a proposal from Duke Loris Visant, a highly esteemed nobleman known for being one of the rare elite bachelors.
As usual, Liosette assumes it’s just another misunderstanding—
and prepares to end it quickly.

The surprise?
Loris is completely serious.
Not only does he seem to know exactly who she is, but he also shows genuine affection and an oddly strong determination to marry her!

Is he mistaken like the others…
or is this time truly different?
And can a girl who’s grown used to ending engagements…
finally fall in love?
